title: Comfort card
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y4 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: comfort card)
intro: Lesson 18: The Year of Sorrow. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Two great losses
points: Abu Talib, his uncle who protected him
Khadijah, his wife who believed first
Both died in the same year, about 619 CE

panels.title: Sad but patient
points: The Prophet ﷺ wept but said only what pleases Allah
He kept going with his mission

frame.label: Something that helps when we are sad, with an example
Something else that helps, with an example
A third thing that helps, with an example

keywords.def: the year the Prophet ﷺ lost Khadijah and Abu Talib

questions.q: Explain why the Year of Sorrow was so hard for the Prophet ﷺ.
questions.a: He lost his protector Abu Talib and his loving wife Khadijah, and the Quraysh harmed him more.

questions.q: Make a 'comfort card' on the pupil PDF: three things that help when we are sad (from today's lesson), each with an example.
questions.a: Patience; du'a; talking to family or a trusted adult; remembering Allah

questions.q: Extend: what did the Prophet ﷺ say when his son died?
questions.a: The eyes weep and the heart grieves, but we say only what pleases our Lord.

questions.q: Stretch: why did the Prophet ﷺ keep loving Khadijah's memory?
questions.a: She believed in him first and supported him with her wealth and love.

questions.q: Who protected the Prophet ﷺ in Makkah?
questions.a: A) His uncle Abu Talib. Abu Talib protected him, even though he did not accept Islam.

questions.q: The Year of Sorrow was about ...
Think again: is it wrong to feel sad? What helps?
questions.a: No; patience, du'a and family help.
